from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueGainLoss(BaseModel):
    """Fair value change gain/loss reported in a company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this financial report belongs to")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock security code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    fair_value_change_gain_loss: float | None = Field(description="The fair value change gain/loss amount; None if not reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g. '元', '万元'")
    is_valid_for_task: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document is for the target company mentioned in the task")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line or table entry containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_gain_losses: list[FairValueGainLoss]
